extraction.Name: Millie Sully
extraction.Refused/Protested: Not at the time fo delivery but some time before this the Superintendent told me that war we would have to take our patents as they would be issued but I told him that I did not want them.
extraction.Recorded patent: It was some time ago that it was mailed to me I do not remember the date.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I had to sell on account of taxes and some other obligations I had to pay.
extraction.NOTES: Received $5400 in cash for land. Signed receipt for patent. No dependents. In good health. Not married. Document notarized May 7, 1929 by Jas. Wi Cross, Notary Public; commission expires 4-28-32.
